title: FoldableContainer does not emit correct folding_changed signal when FoldableGroups is attached
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.stable, 4.6.1.stable, 4.7.dev2 

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.6.1.stable - Compatibility

### Issue description

When `FoldableContainer`s have a `FoldableGroup` attached, the `folding_changed` signal does not emit at the correct moments, nor correct values.

1. If a `FoldableGroup` does not allow folding all, clicking an already opened container will emit a signal, despite the folding state not changing.
2. Any containers that are folded through the `FoldableGroup` will not emit `folding_changed(true)` at all, despite the folding state changing.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d977d50c-eb54-4119-9f5e-1a3f01f364f2

From this behaviour, it appears the signal only emits when the container is clicked directly, and does not interact with the `FoldableGroup` at all. This was reproducible in all versions where `FoldableContainer` has existed, as such it is not a regression.

Note that `ButtonGroup`s *do* emit the `toggled` signal when untoggled by the button group, which is the more expected behaviour.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create `FoldableContainer`s.
2. Create a `FoldableGroup`, then attach to previous containers.
3. Connect to the `folding_changed` signal from the `FoldableContainer`.

[foldablecontainerbug_2026-03-07.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25820352/foldablecontainerbug_2026-03-07.zip)
